scope: Actual native tags/roles/data attributes and explicit child-owner containment/font equality. No expected kind/textCapable/property values are measurement inputs. Only active prepared states grant component coverage. Other-state direct matches identify current DOM ownership without granting that state coverage. CSS resolution is browser-reported via media queries; physical monitor DPI/OS display scale are unmeasured. No successful Save is intended; actual Save outcomes are recorded. Export waiting UI is sampled through outbound request delay only.
